name: malimgraph
description: Transform PDF documents into structured knowledge graphs with citation provenance. Extract entities, build graphs, chunk for RAG, render HTML, and load into Neo4j or pgvector.

tools.name: read_pdf
tools.description: Read PDF, extract text and rule-based entities. First step of any knowledge graph workflow.

tools.name: save_knowledge_graph
tools.description: Build and save a knowledge graph from Claude-extracted entities and relationships.

tools.name: chunk_document
tools.description: Split PDF into overlapping chunks for RAG / vector embedding pipelines.

tools.name: render_document_html
tools.description: Render PDF as structured HTML with page anchors, TOC, entity annotations, and search.

tools.name: manage_graph_db
tools.description: Load, query, and manage knowledge graphs in Neo4j or Apache AGE (PostgreSQL).

tools.name: embed_and_store_chunks
tools.description: Generate embeddings for chunks and store in PostgreSQL pgvector for semantic search.
